about: Batch 8 (4 Nov 2026, the owner: 'we need to make our prices more accurate'). The live model's own recipe (greyhound/live.py: every engine block card-safe, the race simulator, log(BSP), learning rate 0.05, from 2024, rescaled to the SP book) with its prices stretched within each race: on 4 Nov's 17 settled races the prices looked compressed (the 1.59 favourite priced 2.27, the 14.0 outsider 9.25). One fit; each calibration fitted on the fit's early-stopping tenth (rows the trees never trained on), scored on the test window against the uncalibrated prices on the same runners, paired by day: stretch (one b by least squares on the race-centred log(BSP)), temper (one b maximising the winners' likelihood), and each per track, shrunk to the overall b (Harlow was the weak track on 4 Nov). Beside it, the same with the weigh-in (card-unsafe in the morning; on the day's cards at 12 tracks since 7 Oct) and the first_bend and style_draw blocks, the best additions of batches 2-5, calibrated the same way: how much of the gap is information rather than scale.
